comparison.objective: Hold a cutting board over a pot and scrape chopped vegetables into it; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual board positioning and distributed scraping/material transfer versus narrow-tool alignment, striking, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Vegetable pieces transferred from board to pot versus four fractures and physical containment with no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual tool use is generic; scraping bulk pieces into a vessel does not test notched fracture or retained-component protection.
